tools.name: list_packages
tools.description: List 99tests packages, prices (INR + GST and USD), session counts, devices and turnaround.

tools.name: create_test_job
tools.description: Create a 99tests test job and return a hosted checkout link to pay in a browser. Never charges a card directly.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Check a job's stage and progress using the customer's own status link or token. Poll at most every 10 minutes.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Get the verified findings for a delivered job as ready-to-paste fix prompts, using the customer's own status link or token.

tools.name: get_sample_report
tools.description: Get a description and link to an example 99tests report, so you can see the format before paying.
